events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: 30 years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's influence still resonates today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his death
events.blurb: Rock icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, 56 years after we lost him. His guitar work changed everything.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969 in the UK, with the US release following on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album is 57 years old. That zebra crossing photo is still instantly recognisable worldwide.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Still a Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released in the UK 51 years ago today. Its message of peace and unity still resonates.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember the Click Wheel?
angles.copy: It's been 25 years since the original iPod dropped! Remember your first one and all those songs?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy and the anniversary of the first film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film, actor, or theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Double Album, Double Impact
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' is 58 years old this month. A double album full of masterpieces!

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years after we lost one of the greatest performers of all time. His voice lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul' album is 61 years old today! Which track is your favourite from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, music legend John Lennon was tragically killed.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally.
